home.title: Superteam Academy
home.description: Learn Solana development with interactive courses, on-chain credentials, and gamified progression.
home.heroSubline: Interactive courses, verifiable on-chain credentials, and a gamified learning path built for the next generation of Solana developers.
home.featureCredentialsDesc: Earn verifiable, soulbound NFT credentials stored on Solana as proof of your skills.
home.featureInteractiveDesc: Write and test real Solana programs directly in the browser with instant feedback.
home.featureGamifiedDesc: Earn XP, maintain streaks, unlock achievements, and climb the leaderboard.
home.featureOpenDesc: Built on Solana with open standards. Your credentials are yours — portable and permanent.
home.howItWorksSubline: Three simple steps to go from zero to Solana developer.
home.step1Desc: Sign up with Google, GitHub, or your Solana wallet. Your profile tracks everything — XP, streaks, and credentials.
home.step2Desc: Follow interactive courses with real code challenges. Write, deploy, and test Solana programs in the browser.
home.step3Desc: Complete courses to receive verifiable, soulbound credentials stored on Solana — proof of your skills forever.
home.featuresSubline: Everything you need to become a professional Solana developer.
home.pathsSubline: Structured paths from beginner to advanced. Pick your track and start building.
home.pathFundamentalsDesc: Learn the core concepts — accounts, transactions, programs, and the Solana runtime.
home.pathDeFiDesc: Build token programs, AMMs, lending protocols, and understand DeFi composability on Solana.
home.pathFullStackDesc: End-to-end dApp development — from Anchor programs to React frontends with wallet integration.
home.testimonialsSubline: Hear from developers who have accelerated their Solana journey with us.
home.testimonial1Quote: Superteam Academy's interactive challenges made Solana click for me. I went from zero to deploying my first program in two weeks.
home.testimonial2Quote: The on-chain credentials are a game-changer. I can prove my skills to any team in the ecosystem with verifiable proof on Solana.
home.testimonial3Quote: The gamified progression kept me motivated through the advanced tracks. The streaks and XP system made learning addictive.
home.ctaSubline: Join a growing community of developers mastering Solana. Free, open-source, and built for builders.
